en: Status: [OPTIMIZE] Added gepMaintain() to exec-optimizer for native GEP asset maintenance (dedup candidates, archive old events). Ran maintenance: events.jsonl 80→60, candidates 39→16. Reduces repeated exec calls by consolidating Python+manual checks into single Node.js call.
zh: 状态: [优化] 为 exec-optimizer 新增 gepMaintain() 函数，原生 Node.js 实现 GEP 资产维护（去重候选 + 归档旧事件）。执行维护：events.jsonl 80→60 行，candidates 39→16 条。将 Python 脚本 + 多次手动检查合并为单次调用，减少 exec 重复使用。
